remarks: Step into this stunning home that combines classic charm with an unexpectedly spacious and open layout! Beyond its elegant facade, you'll find cathedral ceilings that soar above expansive living areas, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout. The home features a variety of rooms and additional hidden spaces, offering endless possibilities for personalization. Each room flows seamlessly into the next, giving a sense of openness rarely found in traditional Colonials.  Radiant heated floors throughout the entirety of the home..
